decisions.reason: This door lever handle family remains tightly aligned with the firm's core engineering, design and certification knowledge, so continued market learning favors refinement over withdrawal.

The multifunctional door lever handle builds on the firm's established ergonomic and system-solution capabilities, making it more likely that management will improve it through accumulated user feedback than remove it.
As a standard-adjacent door lever handle line, it fits the firm's existing absorptive base in architectural hardware and is therefore likely to stay in the portfolio.
The door and window handle collection combines strong fit with the firm's product-family logic and external design validation, so dropping it within a year is very unlikely.

The light patinated bronze finish is well within the firm's finishing competence and supports coordinated ranges, though finish options remain somewhat more exposed to demand rationalization than core hardware platforms.
